title: Birth in Pineville and the Star Theatre job in Shreveport
summary: Lovett says he was born in Pineville, moved to Alexandria then Shreveport, and spent about eight years in a theatre band there before coming to Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We'd like to start this interview now with Mr. Samuel "Baby" Lovett by asking him about his early childhood; where he was born and how he moved up here to Kansas City. Baby, as I understand it you were born in Pineville, Louisiana. Tell us about your childhood and your parents, and whatever you think is of interest.

Well, I was born in Pineville, Louisiana and I came to Alexandria, Louisiana when I was a very, very young man. And I moved from Alexandria, Louisiana to Shreveport, Louisiana, and I had a job in Shreveport at the Star Theatre, Texas Avenue. And I was there for I guess about eight years all together, playing with a fine band and I left --
when I left the theatre I started playing with different bands around in Kansas City. And I --
What year would that be, Baby?
In Shreveport that was in the thirties. No, twenties, it was in the twenties, in the twenties, it was in the twenties.
What year did you come to Kansas City?
